_note: DRAFT talent pool v2 (2026-10-24, Brent's request: expand the prime talent pool using the affinity roles as a clustering guide). NOT loaded by the game; game/data/talents.json is untouched. Clusters come from the 18 affinity roles in design/affinities/framework.md [B: roles and parents] merged where they overlap [MODEL]. A talent's cluster and roles say what playstyle it serves best; they do NOT tie it to an affinity: talent and affinities are still rolled independently (Brent 2026-10-11) [B]. The 40 existing talents keep every field unchanged and only gain 'cluster' and 'roles'. New talents carry status 'new', provenance [MODEL] (all names, verses, rules and numbers are ours), evolve_2..evolve_4 plus evolve_onward (how it continues; every star ascends, Brent 2026-10-24), and a 'build' note: the existing TalentEffect hooks it uses and the new hooks it needs (see talents-v2.md 'New hooks'). 'roles' use the role ids listed in each cluster; holy and unholy roles belong to affinities listed but not yet in the game. No book text, no canon talent names.

burst_caster.role: Burst caster - big hits, spreading burns

paladin_support.role: Paladin / support (Holy: listed, not in the game yet)

berserker.role: Berserker - spilled life, never your own

evasive_monk.role: Evasive monk - positioning, rear hits, speed

shadow_knight.role: Shadow knight (Unholy: listed, not in the game yet)

coating.role: Coating - tainted water that pays out later

clusters.name: Bulwark (tank / area control)
clusters.summary: Taking hits and owning ground: damage thresholds, delays, immunity, and claimed space enemies must cross.

clusters.name: Bruiser
clusters.summary: Heavy blows, shoves, Crushes, poise and trading hits up close.

clusters.name: Burst and ranged caster
clusters.summary: Big numbers from skills: openers, essence and reflux spent hard, echoes. Fire's burst and Light's ranged smite merge here; both are 'one big cast' players.

clusters.name: Control caster
clusters.summary: Stops, interrupts, slows and statuses that keep enemies from acting.

clusters.name: Healer and sustain
clusters.summary: Recovery between fights and at a price: wounds, sinks, rest. Never in-fight healing that outpaces damage (design/04 balance rule).

clusters.name: Support / wards
clusters.summary: Wards on the ground, buffs shared with thralls and lures, refusing harm. In a single-player game 'allies' are your thralls and lures.

clusters.name: Assassin
clusters.summary: Rear hits, being unseen, darkness, one target marked for death.

clusters.name: Summoner / necromancer
clusters.summary: Thralls, lures and corpses: more of them, longer, and hitting with you.

clusters.name: Druid / growth
clusters.summary: Plants, growth patches, clouds and the slow turn of a fight; some foraging.

clusters.name: Berserker
clusters.summary: Momentum, kill streaks, pain turned into power, never backing off.

clusters.name: Enchanter
clusters.summary: Mind statuses (asleep, dazed, terrified, commanded) that turn enemies on each other, and misdirection.

clusters.name: Spellblade
clusters.summary: Weaving bare strikes, dashes and skills so each feeds the next.

clusters.name: Evasive / mobility
clusters.summary: Movement, dodging, travel and getting out.

clusters.name: Duellist
clusters.summary: One opponent at a time: reading, cutting wind-ups, finding seams, wearing armour well.

clusters.name: Drain / shadow knight
clusters.summary: Taking from enemies: essence, strength, healing into sinks, fear as armour. The title talent lives here.

clusters.name: Damage over time / coating / plague
clusters.summary: Damage-over-time that waits, spreads, coats a weapon or grows with every death. Poison's coating and Disease's plague merge here.

clusters.name: General / utility / economy
clusters.summary: Talents no combat role owns: trade, perception, the Netherecho, the body's oddities. The economy and odd talents the books are known for.

talents.name: 1% Lifesteal
talents.verse: Wound the living a hundredfold, and one fold returns to you.
talents.rule: Gain heal points equal to 1% of damage dealt to anything alive. 1-star: Supreme quality only (100 pts/HP any layer).
talents.evolve_2: Dynamic quality: each wound layer healed at its native price.

talents.name: Borrowed Breath
talents.verse: When the last breath leaves, I lend you ten more. I collect.
talents.rule: On lethal damage, keep fighting for 10 s. Afterwards take the prevented damage as structural wounds.
hidden: kills in the window reduce the debt?
talents.evolve_2: Window 15 s; 30% of debt forgiven per kill.

talents.name: Scar Ledger
talents.verse: Every mended break is written down, and the page grows thicker.
talents.rule: Each structural wound fully healed adds +0.5% max HP to that body region, permanently.
talents.evolve_2: Catastrophic wounds add +3% and harden that region against the damage type that caused them.

talents.name: Hunger Engine
talents.verse: What you swallow of the beast, the beast forgives in you.
talents.rule: Eating monster flesh heals superficial damage and grants resistance to that monster's affinity for 10 min.
talents.evolve_2: Also borrow a weak copy of the eaten monster's talent for the duration.

talents.name: Tenth Strike
talents.verse: Nine knocks are courtesy. The tenth opens the door.
talents.rule: Every 10th hit on the same target deals x5 damage.
talents.evolve_2: Every 10th hit also ignores armour; the count survives switching targets once.

talents.name: Grudge
talents.verse: I remember each hand that touched you, and I weigh it.
talents.rule: +2% damage against a specific enemy for every hit that enemy has landed on you. No cap.
talents.evolve_2: Grudges transfer at half value to allies of the grudged enemy.

talents.name: Weight of Coin
talents.verse: Value is a kind of mass. Throw what you can afford to lose.
talents.rule: Thrown currency deals damage proportional to its face value. The money is destroyed.
talents.evolve_2: 20% of destroyed value is refunded on a kill.

talents.name: Glass Hour
talents.verse: The first grains fall fastest. After that, you are only sand.
talents.rule: For the first 6 s of any fight you deal x3 damage and take x3 damage.
hidden: applies to DoTs applied in the window?
talents.evolve_2: Each kill inside the window extends it by 1 s.

talents.name: Echo Hand
talents.verse: What you do, you do again, smaller, a moment late.
talents.rule: Every ability repeats once at 25% power after 1 s, from where you stood.
talents.evolve_2: Echo at 40%, cast from your current position.

talents.name: Stubborn Bone
talents.verse: Small insults I do not hear.
talents.rule: Structural damage below a threshold per hit is ignored entirely.
talents.evolve_2: Threshold doubles while below half HP.

talents.name: The Last Inch
talents.verse: You may have all of him but the end of him.
talents.rule: The final 10% of each wound layer takes 90% less damage.
hidden: applies per limb or whole body?
soul damage has a last inch?

talents.name: Debt of Pain
talents.verse: Not now. Later. And a little less.
talents.rule: Incoming damage is delayed 5 s, then arrives at 80%.
hidden: healing in the window pre-empts it?
killing the source cancels its pending damage?
talents.evolve_2: Delay 8 s; pending damage from a dead source is halved.

talents.name: Salt Skin
talents.verse: Nothing festers in salt. Nothing grows there either.
talents.rule: Immune to damage-over-time. Healing received from others is halved.
talents.evolve_2: Reflect 25% of prevented DoT back at its source.

talents.name: Doorframe
talents.verse: Every threshold you have crossed is one threshold.
talents.rule: Step between any two doorways you have touched in the current dungeon.
hidden: sealed entrance counts as a door?
talents.evolve_2: Carry one other person or one corpse through.

talents.name: Long Step
talents.verse: Six paces are yours. The seventh is mine, and I walk further.
talents.rule: Every 7th step covers 5 m instantly in the direction of travel.
talents.evolve_2: You choose which step is the long one, once per count.

talents.name: Unfalling
talents.verse: Down is an opinion.
talents.rule: No fall damage. Walk on walls for up to 3 s.

talents.name: Ledger Eyes
talents.verse: Everything alive keeps accounts. I can read them.
talents.rule: See exact HP, by layer, of anything alive.
hidden: shows a hint of latent aura?
talents.evolve_2: Also shows the target's next intended action half a second early.

talents.name: Yesterday Sight
talents.verse: I show you the room as it was. What it is, you must learn yourself.
talents.rule: Overlay of the room as it was 60 s ago: patrol paths, sprung traps, who was here.
talents.evolve_2: Choose any moment in the last 10 minutes.

talents.name: Price Sense
talents.verse: All things are worth something to someone. I know the someone.
talents.rule: See the true market value of any item, and who would pay it.
talents.evolve_2: See what an item will be worth in 30 days.

talents.name: Wrongness
talents.verse: When the pattern breaks, your teeth will ache.
talents.rule: Sense deviants nearby and hidden clauses on a dungeon's rule card.
hidden: triggers on your own hidden flags?
talents.evolve_2: Identify the deviant's talent category before engaging.

talents.name: Super Farmer
talents.verse: What you plant, prospers.
talents.rule: Crops you tend yield far more.
hidden: living scenery you plant counts as yours?
talents.evolve_2: Tended plants mature in a tenth of the time.

talents.name: Clean Cut
talents.verse: Nothing is wasted that passes under your knife.
talents.rule: Corpses you butcher yield double materials.
talents.evolve_2: Harvest materials from wounds on living targets.

talents.name: Packmule
talents.verse: Load is a number. I have changed the number.
talents.rule: Carry capacity x5; hauled weight never slows you.

talents.name: Fine Print
talents.verse: There is always another clause. I will show it to you.
talents.rule: Hidden clauses in contracts, auction terms and rule cards are visible to you.
hidden: shows clauses the other party doesn't know about?
works on your own vestige's verse?
talents.evolve_2: Once per contract, strike one clause before signing; the other party may not notice.

talents.name: Mender
talents.verse: Broken is a direction. I know the way back.
talents.rule: Spend essence to restore gear durability.
talents.evolve_2: Mend other people's wounds at first-aid grade.

talents.name: Loyal Dead
talents.verse: The last to fall rises first, and rises yours.
talents.rule: The last thing you killed fights for you for 30 s at half strength.
hidden: its kills count as your kills?
talents.evolve_2: Duration lasts until it dies or you kill something else.

talents.name: Swarm Keeper
talents.verse: The small ones were always listening. Now they answer.
talents.rule: Vermin and insects in the environment obey simple commands.
hidden: their deaths matter to other talents?
talents.evolve_2: See through any one of them.

talents.name: Borrowed Hands
talents.verse: Two more hands, and neither of them yours.
talents.rule: A pair of spectral hands holds and uses one extra item.
hidden: do they count as limbs for limb-cost abilities?

talents.name: Thick Soul
talents.verse: There, where others are paper, you are hide.
talents.rule: Your Netherecho projection has ten times the durability.
hidden: resists soul damage in reality too?

talents.name: Concept Tongue
talents.verse: Each of them is one word. I can pronounce it.
talents.rule: See a construct's concept and tier before it notices you. Binding is more likely to succeed.
hidden: naming a concept aloud provokes it?
talents.evolve_2: Preview the named upgrade a construct would give an ability.

talents.name: Anchor
talents.verse: You need not lie down to leave.
talents.rule: Project into the Netherecho while your body keeps walking on simple orders.
talents.evolve_2: Body defends itself with your most-used ability.

talents.name: Rat Tail
talents.verse: A tail. Like a rat has.
talents.rule: You grow a prehensile tail. Holds one light item; improves balance.
hidden: counts as a limb for limb-cost abilities?
talents.evolve_2: Tail is strong enough to hang from and strike with.

talents.name: Furnace Gut
talents.verse: Your waste heat is mine. I will find a use for it.
talents.rule: Reflux never locks an affinity. At 100 it vents as a damaging burst around you and drops to 50, wounding you.
hidden: vent counts as your damage for other talents?

talents.name: Slow Blood
talents.verse: What hurries in others, strolls in you.
talents.rule: Damage-over-time on you ticks at quarter speed for the same total.
talents.evolve_2: The total is also reduced by a third.

talents.name: Twin Clock
talents.verse: You rest twice in the time of once.
talents.rule: Sleep need halved. Meditation purges reflux twice as fast.

talents.name: Spare Parts
talents.verse: What is cut from you is slow to understand it has left.
talents.rule: Your severed limbs obey you for 60 s: crawl, grab, hold a door.
hidden: limb can be reattached inside the window?
talents.evolve_2: Severed limbs last until you regrow the replacement.

talents.name: Heavy Name
talents.verse: They will feel you arrive before they see you.
talents.rule: Your aura presses as if you were one star higher. Does nothing else.
talents.evolve_2: Weak-willed enemies a star below you may flee on sight.

talents.name: Lucky Floor
talents.verse: The first snare is always asleep.
talents.rule: The first trap you trigger fails.
hidden: first per room, per dungeon, or per day?
talents.evolve_2: You learn how the failed trap works.

talents.name: Coupon
talents.verse: Sometimes the price is waived. Do not ask why.
talents.rule: 10% chance a consumable is not used up.
talents.evolve_2: 20%, and you know in advance when the next free one is.

talents.name: Clean Channel
talents.verse: What flows to you freely leaves no stain.
talents.rule: Essence supplied by your satellite generates no reflux.
hidden: tank essence spent alongside it is also clean?

talents.name: Held Ground
talents.verse: Stand long enough and the floor forgets it was ever anyone else's.
talents.rule: Stand still for 1.5 s to claim a 4 m circle around you; it lasts until you step out of it. An enemy entering the circle is Slowed for 2 s (once per enemy per 10 s), and your hits on enemies inside deal +30% poise damage.
hidden: a stone you raise inside widens the circle?
the circle holds when you are shoved inside it?
enemies staggered inside cannot leave it?
enemies inside also hit you harder?
talents.evolve_2: Claimed in 1 s; 5 m; it holds for 3 s after you step out.
talents.evolve_3: Two circles may stand at once; the older one stays where you left it.
talents.evolve_4: An enemy staggered inside a circle cannot leave it until the stagger ends.
talents.evolve_onward: +0.5 m radius per star; a third circle at 7 stars; at 10 stars enemies inside cannot Brace.

build.note: Stillness timer and circle in on_tick (owner position). Draw it as a GroundZone circle with a slowed payload (existing world script). The poise bonus needs adjust('poise_out') where deal_damage applies strike poise.

talents.name: Rebound
talents.verse: What you throw against the wall, the wall throws a little of back.
talents.rule: Each Crush you cause refunds 10% of the essence the shoving skill cost, and your next hit within 3 s counts as heavy.
hidden: an enemy crushed against another enemy pays twice?
Crushes from your thralls' shoves count?
the refund also takes back the reflux?
the heavy hit staggers you a little too?
talents.evolve_2: Refund 20%; the heavy hit's poise damage doubles.
talents.evolve_3: A Crush also nudges the nearest other enemy within 2 m 1 m away, which can Crush in turn (one link).
talents.evolve_4: Crushing an enemy against your own raised stone does not crack the stone.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% refund per star, to 50%; the chain gains a link at 6 and 9 stars.

build.note: Player.on_crush already exists: broadcast it. The refund needs the shoving cast's cost (cast event). ctx.heavy is set in on_outgoing.

talents.name: Weight Kept
talents.verse: The world has tried to move you. It is learning not to.
talents.rule: You cannot be shoved, knocked Aloft or dragged. An enemy shoved into you is Crushed against you as if you were a wall (you lose a little poise). You walk 10% slower.
hidden: you count as Braced for skills that care?
a heavy blow still staggers you?
Crushes against you count as yours for other talents?
thin floors and ice give way under you?
talents.evolve_3: Your dashes no longer stop at bodies: they push them 1.5 m aside.
talents.evolve_4: While you stand still, your heavy blows deal +25% poise damage.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% poise damage per star; at 8 stars an enemy crushed against you is also Dazed 1 s.

build.note: Player.shove() and the Aloft status read adjust('shove_in') (0 = immune). Being a Crush surface: the shove's swept check must treat the player's body as a wall when adjust('crush_surface') says so.

talents.name: Bell Ring
talents.verse: Strike the bent one, and the whole room hears it.
talents.rule: A hit on a Staggered enemy rings it: every other enemy within 5 m loses 15 poise. A killing hit rings twice.
hidden: enemies that stagger from the ring ring in turn?
talents.evolve_3: Rung enemies that are winding up a flagged attack are interrupted (and so staggered).
talents.evolve_4: An enemy staggered by the ring also rings, once per hit.
talents.evolve_onward: +3 poise per star; the cascade goes one step deeper at 6 and 9 stars.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt checks target.has_status('staggered'), then take_poise on _enemies_near. If the 'wakes camps' flag is rolled, call the camp's wake.

talents.name: Change Given
talents.verse: You were handed something. Hand it back while it is still warm.
talents.rule: For 1.5 s after an enemy hits you in melee, your next bare strike on that enemy adds, as flat damage, what its hit took from you.
hidden: counts the part your armour stopped?
a delayed or swallowed hit still counts?
the change can be handed to a different enemy?
missing the window costs you poise?
talents.evolve_2: 2.5 s window, and skills can return it too.
talents.evolve_3: The returned blow is heavy.
talents.evolve_4: Unreturned change is kept: up to two hits' worth for your next strike.
talents.evolve_onward: +0.5 s window per star; at 7 stars the return is 125%.

build.note: Buildable today: record (source, ctx.amount()) in on_incoming (already after armour), add ctx.flat in on_outgoing for a bare strike (melee tag, no ability tag) on that source inside the window.

talents.name: Last Drop
talents.verse: Pour out the cup and I will set the dregs alight.
talents.rule: A skill whose cost leaves you under 10% essence deals x2.5 damage. Once per 10 s.
hidden: burns and statuses it leaves are multiplied too?
your satellite refilling you mid-cast spoils it?
measured across all your stars, or the casting star alone?
talents.evolve_3: The skill's recovery is halved when it triggers.
talents.evolve_onward: +0.25x per star; the cooldown shortens 1 s per star, to 3 s.

build.note: The cast event carries essence before and after and a cast serial; on_outgoing multiplies every hit carrying that serial.

talents.name: Remainder
talents.verse: What you did not use, I keep for you.
talents.rule: When a stopping status you applied (stunned, frozen, pinned, asleep, stilled) ends early, its unused seconds are banked, up to 6 s. Your next stopping status on any enemy is lengthened by the whole bank.
hidden: a kill counts as ending it early?
the bank empties when the fight ends?
banked time works on commanders and bosses?
the bank also lengthens stops put on you?
talents.evolve_2: Bank up to 9 s, kept between fights.
talents.evolve_3: You may split the bank: each stop takes up to half of it.
talents.evolve_4: Banked time also Slows the enemy for the same length after the stop ends.
talents.evolve_onward: +2 s bank per star; at 8 stars the bank also adds stacks, +1 per 3 s spent.

build.note: The status engine's _expire knows whether a status ended early: broadcast it with the seconds left. Lengthening goes through adjust('status_time_out') before add_status.

talents.name: Crowd Sum
talents.verse: Count them. Every third one pays for the others.
talents.rule: In a skill that hits several enemies, from the third enemy struck on, each is given +1 stack of every status the skill carries (+2 from the sixth).
hidden: scenery and corpses count toward the three?
stacks past a status's cap spill to the next enemy?
it counts your thralls caught in the area?
talents.evolve_2: Counts from the second enemy struck.
talents.evolve_3: The skill also deals +5% per enemy beyond the third (at most +25%).
talents.evolve_4: The extra stacks land before the payload, so a status that triggers at a threshold triggers sooner.
talents.evolve_onward: +1 to the extra-stack cap per star past 4; at 9 stars each enemy struck counts double.

build.note: apply_hit is the one place statuses land: a per-cast hit count (cast serial) lets adjust('status_stacks_out') add stacks to the third target on. A simplification of 'per three caught': it needs no look-ahead.

talents.name: Broken Sentence
talents.verse: Stop a word halfway and the speaker forgets the language.
talents.rule: An enemy you interrupt is Dazed for 1.5 s and its interrupted attack goes on its full cooldown. Each further interrupt within 10 s adds 1 s to the daze.
hidden: works on enemies that cannot be staggered?
the cooldown also delays its next attack?
Dazed enemies call for help louder?
talents.evolve_2: Dazed 2 s; the chain window is 15 s.
talents.evolve_3: An interrupted support enemy (censer, drummer) also loses the aura or beat it was keeping.
talents.evolve_4: The third interrupt in a chain Stuns for 1 s.
talents.evolve_onward: +0.25 s per star; at 7 stars the chain never resets inside a fight.

build.note: enemy.interrupt() / interrupt_attack() raise an event naming the interrupter; add_status('dazed') and the attack cooldown are enemy-side calls that exist.

talents.name: Tangle
talents.verse: One rope is a nuisance. Three is a knot.
talents.rule: An enemy carrying two or more different statuses from you moves and attacks 10% slower for each beyond the first (at most 30%).
hidden: it also slows the statuses' own clocks (they tick slower)?
talents.evolve_3: A tangled enemy cannot dash or pounce.
talents.evolve_4: Statuses from anyone count, not just yours.
talents.evolve_onward: +2% per rope per star; at 8 stars the third rope also pins for 0.5 s, once.

build.note: Recount on each status event and keep one generated status on the enemy with a time_mult (the status engine already reads time_mult). No enemy code change; StatusText needs its description.

talents.name: Quiet Room
talents.verse: Those you have stilled do not speak of it.
talents.rule: Enemies under a stopping status from you cannot call for reinforcements or wake their camp, and their allies do not notice them being hit.
hidden: a stopped enemy remembers you when it recovers?
talents.evolve_2: Also while Slowed or Dazed by you.
talents.evolve_3: An enemy killed while stopped makes no sound: its camp stays asleep.
talents.evolve_4: Enemies recovering from your stops lose you for 3 s (they hunt as if you were unseen).
talents.evolve_onward: At 6 stars it covers enemies within 3 m of the stopped one; +1 m per star after.

build.note: The enemy 'reinforcements' signal and the camp's wake check pass through adjust('alert', 1.0, {enemy}); 0 silences.

talents.name: After the Storm
talents.verse: When the noise stops, I give back a third of what it took.
talents.rule: When a fight ends, you receive talent healing equal to 30% of the damage you took in it.
hidden: a fight you ran from counts as ended?
the healing is graded as if Dynamic?
starting a fight within 10 s of the last cancels the payment?
talents.evolve_3: Paid at Dynamic quality (bar to half, then sinks, then bar).
talents.evolve_4: Damage taken in a fight's first 5 s counts double.

build.note: Tally ctx.amount() in on_incoming; pay through owner._spend_heal_points when in_combat turns false. Pays only between fights, inside design/04's balance rule.

talents.name: Night Surgeon
talents.verse: Sleep, and I will sew. Do not ask with what.
talents.rule: Each night's rest fully closes your oldest wound, even one that never closes on its own (a lost arm included). You wake with 10% of one tempering technique's progress gone.
hidden: the technique taken is the one you trained least?
a rest in the field counts as a night?
it closes wounds left by cursed items?
sometimes it takes a skill's bar progress instead?
talents.evolve_3: Two wounds a night.
talents.evolve_4: No toll unless the wound was a lost limb.
talents.evolve_onward: One more wound a night at 6 and 9 stars.

build.note: The night's rest (inn, main.gd) raises 'rest'; Body holds the wound list; tempering state is on the player.

talents.name: Graft
talents.verse: Nothing given to you is wasted. I fold the extra and keep it under the skin.
talents.rule: While your health bar is full, natural healing keeps running into a hidden graft (up to 20% of max health). A new wound takes its sink from the graft first, and when your bar falls below half the graft pours back in at 2% of max health per second.
hidden: healing from others fills it too?
the graft is lost when you leave a passage?
a hit that wounds also empties the graft?
talents.evolve_2: Up to 30%; pours at 3% per second.
talents.evolve_3: Pours from 60% health.
talents.evolve_4: Talent healing past the top of the bar fills it too.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% cap per star; +0.5% per second pour per star.

build.note: Natural healing in body.gd clamps at the bar's top: hand the excess to the effects. The graft is never drawn as a number (like a sink); status_lines says it in words. A 2%/s pour stays under the balance rule.

talents.name: Chalk Line
talents.verse: Draw the line once. Inside it, they owe you courtesy.
talents.rule: The first skill you cast in a fight draws a 3 m ward at your feet for 12 s. Inside it you take 20% less damage and lose 20% less poise, and enemies inside are Lit.
hidden: the ward goes where the skill lands, not where you stand?
talents.evolve_2: A ward for each of the first two skills.
talents.evolve_4: Enemies on the line when it is drawn are pushed out (3 m).
talents.evolve_onward: One more ward per fight at 6 and 9 stars; -2% damage taken per star.

build.note: GroundZone circle for the ward; on_incoming checks the owner is inside; 'lit' status exists. Poise loss in take_hit reads adjust('poise_in').

talents.name: Planted Standard
talents.verse: What you wear for yourself, I plant for whoever stands near.
talents.rule: Each self-buff you cast is also planted on the ground for 6 s in a 4 m circle; you and your thralls inside have it while it stands, even after yours ends.
hidden: the planted copy stacks with yours?
one buff can be planted twice?
lures count as standing in it?
talents.evolve_3: The standard follows you at walking pace.
talents.evolve_4: Planting a second buff on the first makes both last 4 s longer.

build.note: player.buffs is the buff store; the circle re-applies the buff to whoever is inside each tick. Thralls do not read buffs today: until they do it helps only you (outlasting the buff).

talents.name: Stand-In
talents.verse: Give me the blow meant for the small one. I will carry it half the way.
talents.rule: A blow that would kill one of your thralls or lures is moved to you at 50%. Once every 15 s.
hidden: the moved blow ignores your armour?
it saves one whose time has simply run out?
talents.evolve_3: The saved one strikes back at once.
talents.evolve_4: The moved blow cannot wound you; it only touches the bar.
talents.evolve_onward: -5% per star, to 10%; -1 s cooldown per star.

build.note: Thrall.take_hit and Lure.take_hit ask the owner's effects before dying (the same shape as the player's own on_lethal); the moved blow goes through owner.take_hit.

talents.name: Unwelcome
talents.verse: What is pressed on you without leave, I refuse at the door and send home.
talents.rule: Every 20 s, the first harmful status put on you is refused and put on whoever sent it, at the same stacks.
hidden: it refuses statuses from the ground (clouds, zones)?
it refuses your own skills' self-statuses?
a refused status is stronger on the way back?
the timer restarts even when one gets through?
talents.evolve_3: Two refusals held.
talents.evolve_4: A refusal also clears one other status from you.

build.note: Statuses on the player are still few (_take_state and the enemy statuses that reach you). This needs one cancellable entry point for a status landing on the player, with its sender.

talents.name: Watch Fire
talents.verse: Sit by me a while. Nothing creeps up on a fire.
talents.rule: While you stand still, the ground within 8 m counts as lit and enemies inside it are Lit. It goes out 1 s after you move.
hidden: the light also weakens your own Dark skills?
it keeps burning while you meditate?
talents.evolve_2: 10 m; it stays 3 s after you move.
talents.evolve_3: Enemies entering it are Exposed for 2 s (once each).
talents.evolve_4: It burns while you walk, at half the radius.
talents.evolve_onward: +1 m per star; at 7 stars your thralls carry a small one each.

build.note: Light.level_at exists (Dark's light_mult reads it); it needs a temporary light source a talent can add. 'lit' and 'exposed' statuses exist. A Dark holder trades their own darkness bonus for it.

talents.name: Quiet Tally
talents.verse: I keep a book of the ones nobody saw you take.
talents.rule: Each kill that no other living enemy could see adds +1% to your damage from behind, permanently, up to +10% per star.
hidden: the tally is lost when you die?
the bonus is for bare strikes only?
talents.evolve_3: Unseen kills also pay 25% more latent aura.
talents.evolve_4: Terrified or Dazed witnesses do not count.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% cap per star at 6 and 9 stars.

build.note: on_dealt with ctx.killed, then a sight check from each nearby enemy (facing plus a ray, as enemies already see). The bonus applies in on_outgoing when target.is_behind(). The tally is saved talent state.

talents.name: Any Side
talents.verse: Every side of them is the back, if you ask politely.
talents.rule: Once every 8 s, your next hit counts as from behind wherever you stand.
hidden: it works on things with no back?
the charge can be wasted on scenery?
it also counts for your thralls' hits?
a skill that strikes many spends it on all of them?
talents.evolve_3: Two charges.
talents.evolve_4: A kill refills a charge at once.
talents.evolve_onward: -0.5 s per star, to 3 s; a third charge at 8 stars.

build.note: Buildable today: deal_damage reads ctx.has_tag('rear') after on_outgoing runs, so the effect appends 'rear'.

talents.name: Clean Exit
talents.verse: When the work is done, no one remembers the door.
talents.rule: A kill from behind makes you unseen for 2 s: enemies lose you, and those winding up at you lose their target.
hidden: a kill by a skill counts?
enemies that lose you go back to their camp?
talents.evolve_3: Any kill on an enemy that had not hit you counts.
talents.evolve_4: Your first hit out of it is an Opening.

build.note: Player.unseen_from is the one unseen rule: it needs a timed 'unseen' a talent can set. Enemy _pick_target already drops a target it cannot see.

talents.name: Appointment
talents.verse: One name in the book is underlined. The rest can wait.
talents.rule: The first enemy you hit in a fight is your appointment: you deal +60% to it and -20% to everything else. Killing it refunds 25% of your max essence, and the next enemy you hit becomes the appointment.
hidden: the appointment survives you leaving the fight?
if anything else kills it you lose the bonus for the rest of the fight?
talents.evolve_3: You see the appointment through walls.
talents.evolve_4: Your thralls' hits on the appointment get your bonus too.

build.note: Pure pipeline: keep the instance id, reset at fight start. Seeing it through walls is a reveals() outline.

talents.name: Soft Dark
talents.verse: In the dark, your feet forget how to make a sound.
talents.rule: Where it is unlit, sleeping enemies do not wake at your approach and camps notice you at half their range.
hidden: your own light skills break it?
beasts that hunt by smell ignore it?
a first hit from the dark is an Opening?
talents.evolve_3: Also in dim light.
talents.evolve_4: Your first hit from the dark on a sleeping enemy is x2.
talents.evolve_onward: At 6 stars your thralls share it.

build.note: FieldCamps reads zones.json aggro_radius: pass it through adjust('aggro_radius', r, {at}) and use Light.level_at for 'unlit'.

talents.name: Spare Room
talents.verse: There is always room for one more at the table. The oldest guest leaves loudly.
talents.rule: You may keep one more thrall than any skill allows. When a new one pushes the oldest out, the oldest bursts for 50% of its remaining health on enemies within 3 m.
hidden: the extra one keeps its own timer?
talents.evolve_3: Two extra.
talents.evolve_4: Burst thralls leave a corpse you can raise again.
talents.evolve_onward: One more extra at 7 and 10 stars; +5% burst per star.

build.note: The summon kind's cap reads adjust('thrall_cap'); the eviction raises thrall_died with reason 'evicted'; the burst uses _burst_at.

talents.name: Second Shift
talents.verse: The dead work two shifts. Nobody asked them.
talents.rule: A thrall of yours that dies leaves a corpse that can be raised again for half the cost. A twice-raised thrall cannot be raised a third time.
hidden: an enemy necromancer can raise it?
talents.evolve_2: Raised again for a quarter of the cost.
talents.evolve_3: Three shifts.
talents.evolve_4: The next shift keeps any statuses it carried (a burning thrall burns on).
talents.evolve_onward: -5% cost per star; a fourth shift at 8 stars.

build.note: Fallen bodies exist (Death's corpses); a dying thrall lays one marked with its shift count; the raise cost reads adjust('essence_cost').

talents.name: Chorus
talents.verse: When you strike, the ones who follow you strike too, a little late, a little weaker.
talents.rule: Each bare strike you land makes every thrall and lure of yours within 6 m strike its nearest enemy for 30% of that strike's damage.
hidden: their strikes count for your counters (every Nth hit)?
talents.evolve_3: Skills also start the chorus, at 15%.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt for a bare strike iterates your thralls and calls apply_hit through the owner with a 'thrall' tag, the path thralls already use. Chorus hits are tagged 'chorus' and never start a chorus.

talents.name: Turning Year
talents.verse: Every fight is a year, if you wait long enough.
talents.rule: Every 10 s of a fight the season turns: spring (natural healing works in the fight, at half rate), summer (+15% damage), autumn (kills roll their remains twice), winter (15% less damage taken). Each fight starts in spring.
hidden: the year carries over between fights?
the season shows in the sky?
a long fight's second year is stronger?
talents.evolve_3: Each season's effect is +50%.
talents.evolve_4: The season before lingers at half strength.

build.note: fight_time already exists (Glass Hour reads it). Spring needs natural healing to ask adjust('natural_heal_in_combat'); autumn needs the remains roll to ask adjust('loot_rolls').

talents.name: Weedheart
talents.verse: Cut a weed and two come back. I made sure of it.
talents.rule: Each plant you cut or burn seeds a 2 m patch of growth for 5 s; enemies in it are Slowed.
hidden: plants your fires burn without you count?
talents.evolve_3: An enemy standing in it for 2 s is Pinned for 1 s.
talents.evolve_4: Kills inside growth seed a patch too.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt with ctx.is_scenery and ctx.killed lays a GrowthPatch (Nature's world script) with a slowed payload.

talents.name: Pollen
talents.verse: Breathe in. Some of what you breathe out is mine.
talents.rule: Every 5 s in a fight you shed a 3 m cloud for 3 s. Living enemies in it are Dulled; you regain 5 poise a second while in it.
hidden: wind skills blow it at enemies?
talents.evolve_3: 4 m; your thralls in it take 20% less damage.
talents.evolve_4: Enemies leaving it are Slowed for 2 s.
talents.evolve_onward: -0.25 s interval per star; +1 m at 7 stars.

build.note: lay_cloud exists (a cloud GroundZone) and 'dulled' exists (blows do 35% less and cannot stagger you, 6 s; the cloud applies it for its own short time). The poise refill reads adjust('poise_regen').

talents.name: Wild Pantry
talents.verse: The wild keeps a cupboard for you. You must find it each time.
talents.rule: Each passage wall you clear grows one forageable plant somewhere in the level; cutting it drops a crafting material of the level's band.
hidden: the plants are still there next visit?
a rare plant now and then?
talents.evolve_3: You see them on the minimap.
talents.evolve_4: Overland camps you clear grow one too.

build.note: main's wall logic knows a wall is cleared; main._spawn_cuttable exists; the drop table is a new loot row.

talents.name: Grass Remembers
talents.verse: Stand still on my ground and the ground will hold you to it.
talents.rule: An enemy within 6 m that stays still for 2 s is Pinned for 1 s. Each enemy at most once every 8 s.
talents.evolve_3: Pinned enemies take +20% from your hits.
talents.evolve_4: Once every 5 s.

build.note: Buildable today: on_tick tracks enemy positions in range; add_status('pinned') (rooted is its alias).

talents.name: Fever Count
talents.verse: Each one sooner than the last. I count; you burn.
talents.rule: Each kill within 4 s of the last adds one to a streak (max 10): +4% damage and +3% move speed a step. When the streak lapses you are slowed for 0.5 s a step.
hidden: kills by your thralls keep it going?
the streak survives a level change?
the comedown also slows your skills?
talents.evolve_3: A lapsing streak drops to half, not to zero.
talents.evolve_4: The comedown is gone.
talents.evolve_onward: +1 max per star; +0.5% damage a step every 2 stars.

build.note: Kills through on_dealt; damage through on_outgoing; speed through adjust('move_speed').

talents.name: Spent Pain
talents.verse: Keep what they gave you. Spend it all at once.
talents.rule: Damage you take fills a pain gauge (one point per 1% of max health, up to 60). Your next skill spends it all: +1% damage a point.
hidden: delayed damage fills it when it arrives?
the gauge drains out of combat?
a skill that misses still spends it?
talents.evolve_3: A bare strike may spend a third of it.
talents.evolve_4: Spending 50 or more refunds the skill's essence.

build.note: Fill in on_incoming; the cast event empties the gauge into that cast's serial; on_outgoing multiplies its hits.

talents.name: Forward Only
talents.verse: I hold you up while you go forward. Turn, and I let go.
talents.rule: While moving toward an enemy you take 15% less damage; while moving away from the nearest enemy you take 25% more.
hidden: it cares where you face, not where you go?
talents.evolve_3: Charging also gives +10% poise.
talents.evolve_4: No penalty while you are below half health.

build.note: Buildable today: on_incoming compares the owner's velocity with the direction to ctx.source (or the nearest enemy).

talents.name: Butcher's Floor
talents.verse: Spill enough and the floor learns to help.
talents.rule: Each kill by a bare strike leaves a pool of blood. Standing in a pool, your bare strikes come 30% faster.
hidden: Blood holders can gather the pools?
talents.evolve_2: Skills' recovery is 15% shorter in a pool.
talents.evolve_3: Any kill leaves a pool.
talents.evolve_4: Pools last twice as long.

build.note: BloodPool exists (Blood's world script); the strike interval in Player reads adjust('strike_interval').

talents.name: Wrong Waking
talents.verse: They wake from you mistaken about who they hate.
talents.rule: An enemy that wakes from an Asleep you put on it, or comes out of your Dazed, attacks the nearest other enemy once before it remembers you.
hidden: a woken commander turns its squad?
talents.evolve_3: Also after Terrified.
talents.evolve_4: For 3 s after, it treats you as unseen.

build.note: Enemy _pick_target already retargets to lures; it needs a one-attack forced target (or a short variant of 'commanded' that attacks).

talents.name: Toll of Sleep
talents.verse: Every dreamer pays the door a coin. I hold the door.
talents.rule: The first time each enemy suffers a mind status from you (asleep, dazed, terrified, dread, commanded) you regain 4% of your max essence.
hidden: the same enemy pays again after a night?
talents.evolve_3: Each new kind of mind status on the same enemy pays again.
talents.evolve_4: It also lowers the casting affinity's reflux by 3.

build.note: The status engine raises a status event with `by`; essence is on the owner.

talents.name: Passed Along
talents.verse: When the puppet breaks, the strings look for new hands.
talents.rule: When an enemy under a mind status from you dies, the nearest enemy within 6 m is Commanded for 2 s.
hidden: the commanded one stands, or wanders where you aim?
it can pass to a commander?
a passed command can pass again?
it can pass to your own thrall and free it?
talents.evolve_3: It passes on once more.
talents.evolve_4: 8 m, and the two nearest.

build.note: Buildable today: note the target's mind status in on_outgoing (before it dies), act in on_dealt when ctx.killed; 'commanded' exists.

talents.name: Rumour
talents.verse: Fear is a story. Each one who runs tells it to another.
talents.rule: A Terrified enemy of yours that passes within 2 m of another enemy gives it Dread.
talents.evolve_3: Dread spreads one step further.
talents.evolve_4: The second-hand enemies are Terrified instead.

build.note: Buildable today: on_tick scans enemies with 'terrified' by the owner, checks neighbours, add_status('dread').

talents.name: Left Behind
talents.verse: Leave quickly enough and a little of you stays to argue.
talents.rule: Each dash leaves an image of you where it began for 2 s. Enemies treat it as a lure and turn to it.
hidden: the image can be hit, and costs you essence?
ranged enemies waste shots on it?
talents.evolve_3: When the image fades it Dazes enemies within 2 m.
talents.evolve_4: Two images at once.

build.note: Lure (scripts/lure.gd) exists and enemies retarget to it in _pick_target.

talents.name: Lent Edge
talents.verse: What the spell was, the blade remembers for a moment.
talents.rule: For 3 s after a skill, your bare strikes carry its affinity (and so its affinity rules) and add 20% of its essence cost as flat damage.
hidden: the carried affinity builds its reflux too?
each new skill refreshes the window?
talents.evolve_3: The first carried strike applies one stack of the skill's first status.
talents.evolve_4: Carried strikes count as abilities for talents that care.

build.note: Appending the affinity tag in on_outgoing is enough: Heat, Lee and the other affinity rules read ctx tags after the effects run.

talents.name: Weave
talents.verse: Blade, word, blade, word. I like the rhythm; I pay for it.
talents.rule: Each time you alternate a bare strike and a skill, your next skill costs 15% less essence, stacking three times. Two skills in a row, or 2 s without a strike, undoes it.
hidden: a skill that misses keeps the weave?
talents.evolve_3: The weave's third skill has no wind-up.
talents.evolve_4: 3 s grace.
talents.evolve_onward: +1 stack per 3 stars; +2% per stack per star.

build.note: Count bare strikes in on_dealt and casts from the cast event; the cost check in cast_ability reads adjust('essence_cost') BEFORE essence is spent (the existing rule for checks).

talents.name: Out of the Step
talents.verse: The step and the spell were one word. Say them together.
talents.rule: The first skill you cast within 1 s of a dash ending has no wind-up and half its recovery.
hidden: dash skills chain off each other?
a dash skill's own wind-up counts?
talents.evolve_3: That skill also costs 20% less.
talents.evolve_4: It also clears Winded.

build.note: _perform_cast reads windup and recovery from the ability; both pass through adjust before use.

talents.name: Fifth Leap
talents.verse: Four times it stays put. The fifth time it gets restless.
talents.rule: Every 5th skill hit you land jumps to another enemy within 6 m at 50% damage.
talents.evolve_3: Every 4th.
talents.evolve_4: The leap also carries the hit's statuses.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt counts ability hits and calls deal_damage on the next target with a 'leap' tag (not counted).

talents.name: Banked Blow
talents.verse: I take a tenth of every blow and keep it for your next word.
talents.rule: 10% of the damage your bare strikes deal is banked (up to 100); your next skill adds the bank to its first hit as flat damage.
hidden: a skill that misses wastes it?
talents.evolve_3: The bank is split across every target of the skill.
talents.evolve_4: Strikes on Staggered enemies bank double.

build.note: Bank in on_dealt; the first hit carrying the next cast's serial takes it as ctx.flat.

talents.name: Close Shave
talents.verse: Missed by an inch is paid by the inch.
talents.rule: When an enemy's telegraphed attack lands within 1 m of you and misses, you gain +30% move speed and your next hit counts as from behind, for 2 s.
hidden: a miss on your thrall counts?
talents.evolve_3: It also clears Winded.
talents.evolve_4: It also refunds 5% essence.

build.note: The enemy's attack resolution (slam circle, aim line; enemy.gd telegraph) reports a miss that passed within range of the player.

talents.name: Stored Stride
talents.verse: Walk now, run later. I keep the difference.
talents.rule: Every 60 m you walk outside a fight stores a stride (up to 3). A dash in a fight spends one: it costs no essence and never leaves you Winded.
hidden: it fills while you carry a heavy load?
talents.evolve_3: A stride's dash goes 50% further.
talents.evolve_4: Strides fill in fights too, at a quarter of the rate.

build.note: Distance from position deltas in on_tick (out of combat); the dash's cost and Winded check pass through adjust.

talents.name: Narrow Room
talents.verse: Two is a conversation. Three is a crowd, and I leave.
talents.rule: While exactly one enemy is within 8 m, you deal 25% more to it and take 15% less from it.
hidden: your thralls count as a third?
a ranged enemy beyond 8 m counts?
talents.evolve_3: With two enemies near, half the bonus.
talents.evolve_4: Killing the one gives talent healing of 3% of max health.

build.note: Buildable today: _enemies_near exists.

talents.name: Cut the Word
talents.verse: Strike while they are still saying it.
talents.rule: A bare strike that lands while its target is winding up interrupts it, as an interrupting skill would (a flagged attack is staggered).
talents.evolve_3: Ranged shots cut too.
talents.evolve_4: A cut enemy's next wind-up is 30% slower.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% Opening damage after a cut per star.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt checks the target's telegraph and calls interrupt_attack().

talents.name: Seam Finder
talents.verse: All armour is made of pieces. I can find where they meet.
talents.rule: After three hits in a row on the same enemy without being hit, your hits on it pass its front guard and deal 20% more poise damage.
hidden: a hit on its shield breaks the count?
a found seam stays after you are hit?
talents.evolve_3: A found seam stays 5 s after you are hit.
talents.evolve_4: It also ignores the 'metal' class's resistance.

build.note: Passing the front guard is the existing 'through' tag (enemy.take_hit skips guards_front for it): append it in on_outgoing.

talents.name: Second Skin
talents.verse: Wear it long enough and it stops being clothing.
talents.rule: Worn gear's armour counts 50% more, but you can change what you wear only in town or at a rest.
hidden: broken gear is stuck on you?
talents.evolve_3: Gear worn through a whole passage gains +1% armour, permanently (at most +10%).
talents.evolve_4: You may swap one slot in the field once a day.

build.note: Player.armour() and Inventory.equip read adjust. The armour cap in balance.json 'gear' still holds.

talents.name: Small Change
talents.verse: The dying drop things. I pick them up for you.
talents.rule: Each hit on a Dying enemy (below half its health) returns 0.5% of your max essence.
hidden: it also takes the target's poise?
talents.evolve_3: It also takes 1 reflux off the hit's affinity.

build.note: Buildable today: Dying is derived (has_status('dying')).

talents.name: Hollowing
talents.verse: Each touch takes a little of their strength and lends it to your arm.
talents.rule: Each hit weakens its target's blows by 2% (stacking to 20%) and strengthens yours by 1% (stacking to 10%), for 6 s.
hidden: the strength is counted per target, or shared?
the strength wears off all at once?
talents.evolve_3: Hollowed enemies refill poise half as fast.

build.note: The weakness is a status with deals_mult (the key exists on Dulled and Sapped); it needs to scale with stacks.

talents.name: Slow Sip
talents.verse: Little by little, what bleeds out of them seeps into you, only where it does not show.
talents.rule: 2% of the damage your damage-over-time deals goes into your wounds' hidden sinks. It never fills the bar.
hidden: it fills the sinks of wounds that never close?
fires and bleeds on plants count?
with no wounds, it does nothing at all?
talents.evolve_3: With no open wound, it fills the bar, outside fights only.

build.note: Buildable today: on_dealt with the 'dot' tag; Body's sink API. Inside the balance rule: sinks only, never the bar in a fight.

talents.name: Feared Company
talents.verse: Those who fear you hit softly, as if apologising.
talents.rule: You take 10% less damage for each Terrified or Dread enemy within 5 m (at most 30%).
hidden: fear makes them call for help?
talents.evolve_3: At most 40%.
talents.evolve_4: An afraid enemy that hits you anyway is Slowed for 1 s.

build.note: Buildable today: on_incoming counts _enemies_near with the statuses.

talents.name: Withheld
talents.verse: Let it wait in them. Interest accrues.
talents.rule: Your damage-over-time deals nothing for its first 4 s, then everything it would have dealt lands at once, at x1.5.
hidden: a kill before the 4 s loses it all?
the lump spreads as the status does?
topping up the status restarts the wait?
talents.evolve_3: The lump staggers flagged attacks.
talents.evolve_4: If the target dies first, the lump lands on the nearest enemy.

build.note: Pipeline-only version: on_outgoing sets mult 0 on 'dot' hits and stores the amount per target; on_tick releases it. Cleaner if the status engine holds the delay (adjust('dot_delay')).

talents.name: Inheritance
talents.verse: The dead leave their sickness to the nearest relative.
talents.rule: When an enemy carrying 3 or more stacks of your damage-over-time dies, half the stacks pass to each of the two nearest enemies within 5 m.
hidden: an inheritance can be inherited again?
it passes into a corpse you can raise?
talents.evolve_3: The three nearest.
talents.evolve_4: Inherited stacks are fresh (full duration).

build.note: Buildable today: read status_stacks in on_outgoing, pass them in on_dealt when ctx.killed (add_status with `by`). Fire's Alight already jumps on death; this does it for every damage-over-time.

talents.name: Stained Edge
talents.verse: What you last spilled is still on the blade.
talents.rule: For 10 s after you apply a damage-over-time status, each bare strike applies one stack of it.
hidden: shots and thrown things are stained too?
the stain dries when you change weapons?
the stain burns your own hand?
a stained strike counts as a dose for Poison's clock?
talents.evolve_3: Every second strike applies two.
talents.evolve_4: The stain survives a level change.

build.note: Remember the last damage-over-time status from the status event; add_status on bare-strike on_dealt.

talents.name: Census
talents.verse: Every one the sickness takes, I count. The count is a kind of strength.
talents.rule: Each enemy killed by your damage-over-time adds +0.5% to all your damage-over-time, permanently, up to +10% per star.
hidden: the count is lost when you die?
the count also lengthens your statuses?
talents.evolve_3: A kill counts if any damage-over-time of yours was on it, whatever struck last.
talents.evolve_4: Every 50 counted kills, your damage-over-time statuses hold one more stack.
talents.evolve_onward: +5% cap per star at 6 and 9 stars.

build.note: Kills with the 'dot' tag in on_dealt; the bonus in on_outgoing on 'dot' hits; the count is saved talent state.

talents.name: Bad Air
talents.verse: Nobody wants to stand close to you. They are right.
talents.rule: Enemies within 2 m of you for 3 s become Sick.
talents.evolve_4: Sick enemies near you take +10% from your hits.

build.note: Buildable today: add_status('sick') exists (living only).

talents.name: Homing Things
talents.verse: What you lose wanders home. It is slow, but it knows the way.
talents.rule: Once per passage, the first item you drop or lose to death is waiting on your bed at the inn when you next sleep.
hidden: it works on things enemies take?
it brings back the corpse's whole pack?
it can bring back something someone else lost?
talents.evolve_3: Overland too.
talents.evolve_4: It comes to wherever you sleep.

build.note: die_to_corpse and drops raise item_lost; the inn's rest returns it.

talents.name: Lodestone Head
talents.verse: You will always know which way is out. Not why you would want to go.
talents.rule: You always know the direction of the nearest way out of a level, and the minimap shows its arrow.
hidden: it points out of the Netherecho?
talents.evolve_2: Also the nearest doorway you have not been through.
talents.evolve_3: Also the nearest rune stone.
talents.evolve_4: Also, in the Netherecho, the nearest construct of the tier your next lock needs.
talents.evolve_onward: One more kind of thing every 2 stars.

build.note: minimap_info() feeds the HUD; reveals() adds arrows.

talents.name: Taste of Iron
talents.verse: Bite it. Your teeth will tell you what it is worth to you.
talents.rule: Tasting an item tells you its band and one thing about it the description does not say. Tasting a consumable uses it up.
hidden: tasting a scroll tells you the skill?
tasting a cursed item curses you?
talents.evolve_3: Consumables are only half used.
talents.evolve_4: Tasting a rune stone tells you its rune before you read it.

build.note: An inventory action plus reveals(item). Needs items to have something undisclosed to reveal (cursed tolls, hidden properties) - see open questions.
